=SELECT 
  i.id,
  i.idea_title,
  i.categoria,
  i.status,
  i.keyword_cluster_id,
  i.estimated_word_count,
  i.priority,
  i.description,
  k.project_name,
  k.cluster_name,
  k.keyword_principal,
  k.keywords_secundarias,
  rr.id AS existing_report_id
FROM ideas i
JOIN keywords k ON i.keyword_cluster_id = k.id
LEFT JOIN research_reports rr ON rr.idea_id = i.id
WHERE i.categoria = 'Requiere investigación'
  AND i.status IN ('pending','in_progress','research_failed','research_ready')
{{ $json.body?.idea_id ? "  AND i.id = '" + $json.body.idea_id.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "" }}
{{ $json.body?.keyword_cluster_id ? "  AND i.keyword_cluster_id = '" + $json.body.keyword_cluster_id.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "" }}
{{ $json.body?.project_name ? "  AND k.project_name = '" + $json.body.project_name.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "" }}
{{ $json.body?.force ? "" : "  AND rr.id IS NULL" }}
ORDER BY i.priority DESC NULLS LAST, i.created_at ASC
{{ $json.body?.limit ? "LIMIT " + $json.body.limit : "LIMIT 3" }}

=INSERT INTO research_reports (
  idea_id,
  keyword_cluster_id,
  idea_title,
  idea_category,
  model_used,
  status,
  search_queries,
  research_json,
  summary,
  key_insights,
  key_statistics,
  trends,
  sources,
  raw_response
) VALUES (
  '{{$json.idea_id}}',
  {{$json.keyword_cluster_id ? "'" + $json.keyword_cluster_id + "'" : "NULL"}},
  '{{ ($json.idea_title ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.idea_category ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.model_used ?? "o4-mini-deep-research").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.status ?? "unknown" }}',
  '{{ $json.search_queries_sql ?? "[]" }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.research_json_sql ?? "{}" }}'::jsonb,
  {{ $json.summary_sql ? "'" + $json.summary_sql + "'" : "NULL" }},
  '{{ $json.key_insights_sql ?? "[]" }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.datos_clave_sql ?? "[]" }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.tendencias_sql ?? "[]" }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.fuentes_sql ?? "[]" }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.raw_response_sql ?? "{}" }}'::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (idea_id) DO UPDATE SET
  keyword_cluster_id = EXCLUDED.keyword_cluster_id,
  idea_title         = EXCLUDED.idea_title,
  idea_category      = EXCLUDED.idea_category,
  model_used         = EXCLUDED.model_used,
  status             = EXCLUDED.status,
  search_queries     = EXCLUDED.search_queries,
  research_json      = EXCLUDED.research_json,
  summary            = EXCLUDED.summary,
  key_insights       = EXCLUDED.key_insights,
  key_statistics     = EXCLUDED.key_statistics,
  trends             = EXCLUDED.trends,
  sources            = EXCLUDED.sources,
  raw_response       = EXCLUDED.raw_response,
  updated_at         = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
RETURNING id, idea_id, status, summary, created_at, updated_at;

=UPDATE ideas
SET
  status = {{ $json.status === 'completed'
    ? "'research_ready'"
    : "'" + (($json.status ?? 'research_failed').replace(/'/g, "''")) + "'" }},
  description = {{ $items('Parse Research JSON')[$itemIndex].json.summary_sql
    ? "'" + $items('Parse Research JSON')[$itemIndex].json.summary_sql + "'"
    : "description" }},
  processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = '{{$json.idea_id}}'
RETURNING id, status, description, processed_at;
